items.stem: In `class TeamSiteWebPartSink : ISink<TeamSiteWebPart>`, what does `TeamSiteWebPart` bind to?

options.text: The base class of the sink
The interface's type parameter T — the entity this sink handles

items.explanation: TeamSiteWebPart is bound to ISink<T>'s type parameter, so this sink operates on TeamSiteWebPart entities.

misconceptions.a: It's the generic type argument, not a base class — the base relationship here is implementing the interface.

items.stem: When you write `class StaffFeed : IFeed<Staff>`, what must the class provide?

options.text: All members declared by IFeed<T>, with T meaning Staff
A copy of the Synnduit engine

items.explanation: Implementing a generic interface means supplying every member, with the type parameter bound to your entity (Staff).

misconceptions.a: An interface is a contract; you must implement its members.

items.stem: `ISink<T>` declares `T Get(...)`. In `class TeamSiteWebPartSink : ISink<TeamSiteWebPart>`, what is the return type of the Get method you implement?
items.explanation: Binding T to TeamSiteWebPart substitutes it throughout the contract, so Get returns a TeamSiteWebPart.

misconceptions.a: In the implementing class T is already bound to a concrete type — TeamSiteWebPart — not left generic.

items.stem: Describe the three-step shape of writing any Synnduit connector (feed or sink), in terms of generic-interface implementation.
rubric: Pick the interface (IFeed<T> for a source, ISink<T> for a destination)
Bind your entity POCO as the type argument T
Implement all the interface's members (typed to your entity)
items.sampleAnswer: Choose the interface for the direction you need (IFeed<T> to read a source, ISink<T> to write a destination), bind your POCO as <T> (e.g. <Staff>), and implement every member of that interface with T now meaning your entity.

items.stem: Which two prerequisite skills does implementing a generic interface combine?
items.explanation: Implementing IFeed<Staff> requires understanding both the generic type parameter and the interface-as-contract idea.
